svg.text: PolyKybd Split72: key names and aliases from the PCB switch positions
Name L/R:X.Y: X counts columns from the outer edge towards the middle, Y counts rows from the top.
Second line: the alias, counted across the middle from the other half (X 9 to 16). Small text: matrix row,col and footprint (K = SW_K_).
Dashed: expansion-port key, no switch footprint, position from the KLE file.
